user.title: Configure physical zone
user.description: One entry per independently controllable physical zone. Rooms heated by ONE Ecobee must remain ONE zone; software cannot split that heating coverage. Each thermostat/AC can be assigned only once. Starts Off/unowned; enabling acquires equipment. All temperature settings below are Fahrenheit. Verify independent freeze-safe native behavior before enabling.

data.name: Zone name
data.trusted_action_entities: Verified HVAC-action reporters (leave empty for unverified IR)
data.response_sensors: Feedback temperature sensors (empty uses indoor sensors)
data.response_min_samples: Minimum fresh reports per sensor per window

data_description.trusted_action_entities: Select only mapped actuators whose hvac_action you independently verified is actual equipment feedback. IR mode/state is not compressor verification. Every mapped actuator must be trusted for known operation history.
data_description.outdoor_sensor: Optional history trace only; indoor control does not depend on outdoor temperature.

error.invalid_zone: Invalid zone: select sensors and distinct physical actuators, no reuse/virtual entities, keep separated targets, and use safe timing/setpoint bounds. See README for limits.
